title: Expired active reservations can be renewed back to life
description: Evidence: apps/cli/src/commands/agent.ts renews every active reservation for an agent without filtering expired ones; runtime renewal requires active reservation but not non-expired reservation, while agent start/finish reject expired-active claims. Impact: stale claims can be revived instead of forcing repair/reclaim.
acceptanceCriteria: agent renew --all skips or fails expired active reservations and directs repair/reclaim, with tests covering expired-active renewal attempts.
